scenario.name: song-female
scenario.ops_rule: ops with at <= i are applied in list order before output sample i is rendered; all ops here have at = 0, i.e. they run after HumanVoice::new and before the first render() call (so before the first control step)
scenario.provenance: as `chimera render song <dir> female` for DEMO_SONGS[1] "Twinkle, twinkle" (crates/chimera-cli/src/render.rs:211-272; = recon/ref-audio/song-female/twinkle-twinkle-female.wav): HumanVoice::new(48000, BODY_FEMALE, 2), set_source{f0: midi_to_hz(first note), voiced, pressure 9, tension 0.55}, schedule(plan_song(notes, SongOptions{female, bpm 100, t0 0.3, vibrato 35}).gestures), js_round(48000*(plan.end+0.4)) samples in host blocks of 128

info.lyrics: Twinkle twinkle little star, how I wonder what you are.

block_rule: block b = the b-th control() call; it runs before internal sample b*ctrl_every, i.e. before output sample b*ctrl_every/oversample = 64*b; row b = state after the complete control step b, as the kernel consumes it during block b (taken as the last statement of control(); initial = state after the constructor)
